evidence.reason: The fixture initializes a repository and sets only user.name/user.email, then runs `git commit` at line 94 without disabling inherited `commit.gpgSign`. If global or system config enables commit signing and no usable key exists for the fixture identity, the baseline commit fails and every DeployTests case errors in setUp. Setting repository-local `commit.gpgSign=false` before the first fixture commit is the minimal hermetic fix and also covers the later fixture commit.
